'''Trever Flume's father''' was the father of [[Trever Flume]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] right after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended. A doctor during the war, he lived on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] and worked in the [[City/Legends|city's]] defense department. However, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] arrived after the end of the war in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], wanting to take over the defense system. When the people protested, including his eldest son [[Tike Flume|Tike]], the Empire blew up the tower, killing Trever's father and Tike.
